Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting certain military housing from property and leasehold excise taxes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting certain military housing from propertyand leasehold excise taxes; amending RCW 84.36.010; and adding a newsection to chapter 82.29A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 84.36.010 and 2004 c 236 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) All property belonging exclusively to the United States, thestate, or any county or municipal corporation; all property belongingexclusively to any federally recognized Indian tribe located in thestate, if that property is used exclusively for essential governmentservices; all state route number 16 corridor transportation systems andfacilities constructed under chapter 47.46 RCW; and all property undera financing contract pursuant to chapter 39.94 RCW or recordedagreement granting immediate possession and use to the public bodieslisted in this section or under an order of immediate possession anduse pursuant to RCW 8.04.090; is exempt from taxation. All propertybelonging exclusively to a foreign national government is exempt fromtaxation if that property is used exclusively as an office or residence p. 1 SB 6389for a consul or other official representative of the foreign nationalgovernment, and if the consul or other official representative is acitizen of that foreign nation. (2) For the purposes of this section, "essential governmentservices" means services such as tribal administration, publicfacilities, fire, police, public health, education, sewer, water,environmental and land use, transportation, and utility services. (3) For the purposes of this section, "property belongingexclusively to the United States" includes property, both real andpersonal, together with all improvements thereto, regardless of theownership of either, used for the housing of military personnel andtheir families, as provided by the military housing privatizationinitiative of 1996, 10 U.S.C. Secs. 2871 through 2885, as amended.Such improvements, in addition to the actual housing units, include,but are not limited to, facilities related to the housing units, suchas housing maintenance facilities, housing rental and managementoffices, parks, and community centers.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.29A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following leasehold interests are exempt from taxes imposedunder this chapter: All leasehold interests in any property belongingexclusively to the United States, including property owned in part bythe United States, together with all improvements thereto, used for thehousing of military personnel and their families, as provided by themilitary housing privatization initiative of 1996, 10 U.S.C. Secs. 2871through 2885, as amended. Such improvements, in addition to the actualhousing units, include, but are not limited to, facilities related tothe housing units, such as housing maintenance facilities, housingrental and management offices, parks, and community centers.
